modules.name: GENRA CHOP
modules.description: A hip-hop beat generator in the look of an old production center: 29 styles from the 80s to the 2020s (Boom Bap to Trap), drums, bass, melody and pads, a sample chopped onto 16 playable pads with its chords and key found, a break chopped onto the drums, MIDI chop per track, MIDI learn for every control, MIDI export and the chops saved as WAVs

modules.name: GENRA CHOP GRID
modules.description: The grid editor for GENRA CHOP: drum and chop raster, piano roll for bass, melody and pads, velocity and chance, own length and swing per track, track tools, REC MIDI, MIDI export and import

modules.name: GENRA CHOP ABLAUF
modules.description: The song arranger for GENRA CHOP: 64 pattern pads with names, variations for intro, verse, hook, bridge, break and outro, a song list, MAKE SONG in hip-hop song forms, transitions between the parts, song MIDI export

modules.name: GENRA CHOP FX
modules.description: Two effect buses to play live, after the idea of the SP-404: 39 effects (vinyl, cassette, lo-fi, filters, low and high cut, isolator, resonator, drive, compressor, gater, delays, tape echo, reverb, chorus, flanger, phaser, looper, scatter, stopper, tape stop, backspin, downer, sub octaver), eight sources in and out on their own jacks (for a mixer with one fader each), returns and a mix out, a little screen above every control, FX ON to tap or hold, eight quick keys, eight DJ pads and a DJ filter on all outputs, presets, synced to a 16th clock, CV and MIDI learn
